name: British Literature I: Middle Ages to the Eighteenth Century and Neoclassicism (Robinson and Getty)
goodFor: An anthology of British literature from the Middle Ages to the eighteenth century, with introductions and review questions, for a survey course.

Robinson and Laura Getty (University of North Georgia Press), linked to https://oer.galileo.usg.edu/english-textbooks/17/; "CC BY-SA 4.0", linked to https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/; and, when the text shown was shortened or changed, a note that it was.

notes: Checked against the book's own page in the GALILEO Open Learning Materials repository (ALG Commons, run by Affordable Learning Georgia, the book's co-publisher with the University of North Georgia Press), which states CC BY-SA 4.0 for the whole work; the repository's FAQ says each document carries its own Creative Commons licence, so the licence is set per book and only this book was read. The University of North Georgia Press's own page for the book agrees that it "can be reused, remixed, and reedited freely without seeking permission" (re-read 2026-11-18); that agreement is what separates this record from ung-world-literature-ii and dorrell-intro-human-geography, whose press pages state nothing about reuse and which are set aside. CC BY-SA allows commercial use; what Ceder changes stays under CC BY-SA 4.0. The anthology reprints works by over 50 authors and has over 100 historical images; the page does not say where each text, translation or picture comes from, so a picture or a translation of an older-language work (for example Old or Middle English) should have its source checked before it is shown. The repository's FAQ and About pages were read and add no other terms; its footer Copyright link goes to Elsevier's website terms for the Digital Commons platform (www.elsevier.com, not reachable), which were not read. The book is a 49 MB PDF; the page lists no HTML version.
